environment.description: Deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Application runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. API keys distributed to third-party inventory partners.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP mode, no HTTP inspection
